key_concepts: Actions to take before an earthquake follow local disaster readiness plans
During earthquake shaking, take cover under sturdy furniture
Stay away from windows and heavy objects during shaking
After an earthquake, check for injuries and assess damage
Evacuate to safe assembly areas if necessary after an earthquake
Tsunami alerts may use sirens, loudspeakers, text messages, and social media
Emergency responders mobilize resources and coordinate evacuation during tsunami alerts
Community members should follow evacuation procedures and gather at designated assembly po
Sharing preparedness information with families and friends promotes community preparedness
